scope: Synthetic constrained component test using original Vehicle vocabulary; no pretrained policy outputs
loss: interpolated common label bank, sigmoid((0.005-gap)/0.006) + 0.02*lost_progress; fixed primitive uses expected bank cost
validation_selection: lowest shared-bank validation loss; test never selects hyperparameters
test_reference: adaptive SAT separation certificate with vertex motion bounds; unresolved distinguished from collision
gpu_gate: No GPU plan without stable raw-generation improvement against matched fixed primitives AND projected residual, meaningful margin and real policy evidence
